def thaw_from_args(parser):
    """Adds command line options for things related to inline thawing
    of icefiles"""
    parser.add_argument('--thaw-from',
                        dest='thaw_from',
                        action='store',
                        default=None,
                        help='Path to a directory containing a thawed '
                        'icefile.')
    parser.add_argument('--thaw-to',
                        dest='thaw_to',
                        action='store',
                        default=None,
                        help='Path to a directory to thaw the icefile to.')

                        dest='thaw_to_file',
                        action='store',
                        default=None,
                        help='Path to a file to thaw the icefile to.')
